seo.title: Meet Len
seo.description: Dr. Len Tau, The Reviews Doctor, built his Philadelphia dental practice to 4.9 stars and 2,000+ reviews. Now he teaches the system as a speaker, author, consultant and podcast host.

prose.title: How I got here.
paragraphs: When I was a kid, I wrote a list of eleven life goals on a sheet of paper. Retire by 50. Live in Florida. Write a book. I forgot about it for decades. I found that page while packing to move to Florida. I had checked off all eleven.
I followed my father into dentistry. I went to Tulane, then Tufts School of Dental Medicine, class of 1999. I did my AEGD residency at UMDNJ in southern New Jersey.
Then I spent 23 years at the Pennsylvania Center for Dental Excellence outside Philadelphia. Philadelphia Magazine named me a Top Dentist.

I built that practice on clinical work and word of mouth. Then I noticed something. The fastest-growing practices around me were not always the best clinically. They were the easiest to find and the most trusted online.
So I built a system. Ask every patient for a review. Answer every review. Keep every listing accurate. The practice grew to a 4.9-star average and 2,000+ reviews.
The system worked well enough that I turned it into a company, iSocial Reviews. Birdeye acquired it in 2014. Today I serve as General Manager of Birdeye's dental division.

I sold my practice in 2021. Now I teach the system full time. I've given 600+ presentations. I wrote Raving Patients, 100+ Tips to Generating 100 5-Star Reviews in 100 Days, and now Raving Patients Supercharged. I host the Raving Patients Podcast every Friday and the Supercharge conference every year.
Education without action is just entertainment. If you want to be the go-to practice in your area, let's talk.

items.q: Why listen to a dentist about marketing?
items.a: Because I did it myself first. I spent 23 years in practice and built it to a 4.9-star average and 2,000+ reviews before I ever taught the system.
Practice owners and their teams. General and specialty practices, usually one to five dentists, who know they do great work and want their online presence to show it.
Search your own practice on Google the way a new patient would. Then book a call with me and we will look at it together.

items.q: Can you remove a negative Google review?
items.a: If it breaks Google's rules, often yes. Fake reviews, reviews from competitors, and reviews from former employees can come down. My team submits them for you. You pay $450 only if Google removes the review.

items.q: Can I be a guest on the Raving Patients Podcast?
items.a: I am always looking for doctors and team members with something useful to share. Apply at podcastguest.drlentau.com.

items.q: Do you speak at meetings and study clubs?
items.a: Yes. I speak nationally on reviews, reputation and online visibility. See my topics on the Speaking page, then send me your date and group.

items.q: What is Supercharge Your Dental Practice?
items.a: My annual conference for practice owners and teams. Practical systems, new connections and clarity for the year ahead.
